name: bing-webmaster-ai-cli-mcp
description: Check whether Bing has crawled and indexed a page and review Bing search traffic. Writes are only planned for a person to apply: the bundled server starts with BING_WM_ALLOW_WRITES=false.

api_key.title: Bing Webmaster API key
api_key.description: API key from Bing Webmaster Tools (Settings > API access). Stored in the system credential store.
